commentary_segments.text: Connection of a set of positive diode resistances with negative ones, allows the realization of any resistance between 1/g and infinity. m Making all devices the same cancels the AC current in this circuit, causing the differential to be very high (infinity if matching is perfect). It is therefore an ideal load for a differential amplifier.
